mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows WHERE following_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.nickname, u.preferences, u.created_at, u.updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows ff WHERE ff.following_id = u.user_id), 0) AS follower_count, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows fg WHERE fg.follower_id = u.user_id), 0) AS following_count, CASE WHEN #{actorUserId} IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM follows fm WHERE fm.follower_id = #{actorUserId} AND fm.following_id = u.user_id ) END AS followed_by_me FROM follows f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.follower_id WHERE f.following_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
